notes: Assumptions that change the number: livers raw and trimmed; full 250 ml fresh cream (~36 % fat); the four Portuguese rolls (70 g each, 176 kcal) are counted because they are an ingredient line; no quantity was given for the parsley, so none is counted. Sanity check: published creamy peri-peri livers for 4 come in at 220–423 kcal without bread (Tantalise My Tastebuds 423 kcal, a Portuguese-style one 402). Ours is 560 without the rolls, about 33 % more, because this recipe uses 750 g livers and a full cup of cream where those use ~500 g livers and about ½ cup.
